rows.grounds: relative pronoun indicating the basis or support
that on which reliance is placed
demonstrative pronoun referring to the mother
power or force; first member of compound with uddhatā
raised or exalted; qualifies mātā together with bala

items.question: By whose support can this strength-uplifted mother become beneficial?
premises: This mother is uplifted by strength.
Her becoming beneficial depends on a specific support.
Reliance on that support enables her beneficial nature.
items.inference: The strength-uplifted mother becomes beneficial through reliance on that particular support.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yad āśrayāt is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: By relying on which support may this mother, uplifted by strength, become beneficial?
